candidate_policy: Evolver proposes one candidate from the current parent and names one target task
candidate passes local component smoke and admission
one normal-budget blind Worker evaluates the named target
only a target gain triggers one independent target repeat and a fresh parent comparator when the parent cache is not current
only a repeated target gain triggers one matched protection evaluation
only a protection-safe candidate becomes the next parent version
short_probe_role: activation and completion-distance diagnostic only; lack of artifacts is not a numeric rejection when the probe budget is shorter than the task's observed completion distance

cache_policy.reuse: reuse a completed parent-task comparator while the parent version and run contract are unchanged
cache_policy.invalidate: invalidate only after parent promotion or a run-contract change

parallelism.within_lineage: parallelize eligible Worker evaluations but serialize parent promotion

main_0_rehearsal.purpose: exercise proposal, normal target, repeat, protection, promotion, rollback, resume, accounting, and freeze without manual run repair

main_1_initial_panel.task_selection: workflow-lineage-separated quant task families after source and runtime screening
main_1_initial_panel.primary_result: frozen evolved harness versus Quant-H0 on sealed official reward, with task vectors and property counts reported separately

stopping: all selected optimize targets resolved or one complete pass yields no promoted candidate
promotion_evidence: actual component activation or evidence-grounded skip
claim_boundary: This is a scale runway, not a completed scheduler or a main-experiment result. Exact Main-1 tasks and budgets remain to be preregistered after Main-0.
